name: Campaign Planning
description: Produces a completed marketing campaign brief with objective, audience, message hierarchy, channels, timeline, creative requirements, and success metrics. Use when the user asks to plan a marketing campaign, create a campaign brief, structure a promotional push, or design a multi-channel campaign with specific goals and timelines. Do NOT use for ongoing marketing strategy (use marketing-strategy), email sequence design (use email-campaign), or single ad copy creation (use paid-ad-copy).
